name: CRECE: Working Capital Crunch
description: Cash flow and working capital management simulation for a fast-growing SME in Latin America. Manage the Cash Conversion Cycle, financing instruments, and supplier/customer relationships to survive a growth-driven liquidity crisis.
view:
CRECE: Working Capital Crunch

Cash Flow Management for Growth

Month 1 of 12

Situation Briefing

You lead CRECE Distribuciones, a growing consumer goods distributor that just secured a transformational contract with MAXMART. Revenue will increase 43%, but your working capital cannot sustain the growth. Manage collections, payments, inventory, and financing to survive the cash crunch.

CCC Breakdown

Period Decisions

Higher = lower DSO, but heavy dunning loses repeat orders
Higher = keeps cash longer; suppliers paid late raise prices and shorten your terms
Lower = frees cash; below about 20 days you lose sales to stockouts
Cash now for 3% of each invoice sold; the rate rises above 40% of the book
